To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the concept of Industry  4.0 is discussed and an increasing role of agent-oriented and social technologies for the development of smart enterprises, cyber-physical systems, the Internet of things, and collaborative robots is shown; 2) the arrival of these technologies is opening new frontiers in the development and study of artificial societies; and 3) the representation of a networked enterprise as an agent society of natural, artificial, and software agents is suggested.

the concept of Industry 3.0 can be extended and generalized to include the concept of enterprise total agentification as a way to Industry 4, and that the formation of artificial societies via GRPA architecture and colored goal resource networks is the way to achieve this goal.
the enterprise total agentification is a way to Industry 4 and the goal resource network formalism is an adequate tool to visualize and study artificial societies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a formalization of the agentification of enterprises as an approach to Industry 4.
a new approach to the modeling and simulation of enterprise as a networked society of natural, hardware, and software agents.
the development of a formal approach and software tools to support the design and analysis of agentified enterprises and to study the emergence of artificial societies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the concept of artificial societies can be used as a way to Industry 4,0.
the agentification of enterprise is the most promising way to achieve Industry 4. 0 and to form artificial societies.
agentification is the most promising way to Industry 4.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new approach to modeling of networked enterprises is proposed and some basic elements of this approach are introduced and illustrated.
the goal resource approach is a good candidate to be a formal foundation for enterprise modeling and simulation.
a new network formalism is proposed and a new approach to enterprise modeling and simulation is introduced.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the concept of agentification is the key to understanding Industry 4. 0, as it is to understanding the human society, as it was in the past, and it will be in the future.
agent based technologies are becoming more and more important in Industry 4. and the concept of artificial societies can be used to study and develop new technologies for enterprise management.
agent oriented and social technology is a key to the development of Industry 4,0, and the goal resource networks can be a useful instrument to model and analyze the behavior of multi agent systems.
